sanskrit_verse: भेदनोपेक्षया न्यासं ग्रहीता यदि नाशयेत् । याच्यमानो न दद्याद् वा दाप्यस्तत्सोदयं भवेत् ॥
transliteration: bhedanopekṣayā nyāsaṃ grahītā yadi nāśayet | yācyamāno na dadyād vā dāpyas tat sodayaṃ bhavet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: If a receiver destroys the entrusted item through negligence or deliberate omission, or refuses to return it when requested, restitution must occur with accrued value and conscious completion.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious acceptance of stewardship
Causation is established by neglect or willful refusal
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to awareness of duty
Restoration logic requires return plus value erosion compensation
executable_legal_axioms: IF (agent accepts item IN_TRUST) AND (item is LOST OR DESTROYED OR NOT_RETURNED_UPON_REQUEST) THEN RESTITUTION = principal_value + accrued_depreciation_loss
IF (negligence_level > threshold_of_conscious_awareness) THEN restoration_process INCLUDES capacity_rehabilitation_protocol
IF (intentional_refusal_TO_RETURN IS TRUE) THEN initiate_completion_process UNTIL responsibility_is_fully_assumed
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall determine stewardship threshold based on documented acceptance and awareness. Responsibility is non-transferrable once conscious assumption occurs. Value restoration includes inflation-adjusted depreciation. No punitive damages allowed—only asset-value parity restoration.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal chain: acceptance → duty → failure → loss. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces negligence or intent. Proportional responsibility aligns with conscious capacity at time of failure. No punitive consequence is enacted; only value-equivalent restoration is executed.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Agent must fully account for item until replacement or equivalent value is restored
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Conscious reaffirmation of duty until restitution is complete
Capacity Restoration: If negligence stems from unawareness, education and reintegration into dharmic function
Integrity Reintegration: Public acknowledgment of duty lapse and conscious correction
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of Dharma, this law is executed. Justice is restoration, not retribution. Consciousness is the final arbiter. Dharma is restored.
